title: Community - Lego
summary: A short clip from the NBC sitcom Community in which a character delivers a monologue about how LEGO changed over the years. It is the source of a widely quoted passage about the toy.
why: HN commenters link it as the origin of a LEGO quote and as a delightful monologue about how the toy has changed.
